name: qr_code_generator
description: Generate QR codes for URLs, plain text, WiFi configurations, or contact info. Saves as PNG to stash for printing, canvas display, or email attachment. Use when user says 'create a QR code', 'make a QR code for', 'generate QR', 'QR code for wifi', 'QR code for website'.

type.description: Type of QR code: 'text' for plain text, 'url' for websites, 'wifi' for WiFi network config, 'email' for email addresses. Defaults to 'text'.

content.description: The content to encode. For text/url/email types, put the value here. For wifi, you can put the SSID here or use the ssid parameter.

ssid.description: WiFi network name (SSID). Required for type='wifi'.

password.description: WiFi password. Used for type='wifi'. Leave empty for open networks.

security.description: WiFi security type: 'WPA' (default), 'WEP', or 'nopass' for open networks. Used for type='wifi'.

hidden.description: Whether the WiFi network is hidden. Default false. Used for type='wifi'.

filename.description: Optional custom filename for the saved PNG. Auto-generated if not provided.

box_size.description: Pixels per QR module/box. Default 10. Higher = larger image.

border.description: Border width in QR modules. Default 4 (QR spec minimum).
